source: Calling all three “embeddings” is not necessarily wrong, but it becomes dangerous when reasoning about memory, training, similarity, or reuse. A vocabulary embedding matrix lives in the model parameters. Contextual states are produced per input. A document embedding can often be precomputed and stored outside the model.
zh: 将所有三种称为“嵌入”不一定是错误的，但在推理记忆、训练、相似性或重用时会变得危险。词汇嵌入矩阵存在于模型参数中。上下文状态是根据输入生成的。文档嵌入通常可以预先计算并存储在模型外部。
